'''''Silencer-6''''' was a [[World Devastator]].

==History==
''Silencer-6'' participated in the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].
During the battle, the World Devastator was hit by enemy fire and reported damage to its munitions warehouse.
